headline: Canva Announces 22% Workforce Reduction and Return-to-Office Mandate
summary: Canva has announced layoffs affecting approximately 22% of its workforce. The company is also shifting its hybrid work policy, requiring staff to spend two to three days in the office starting in January.
why: Canva is a major private technology company in the design software space. Large-scale layoffs and changes in remote work policies are often indicators of cost-cutting measures or strategic shifts in the tech sector.
